fit: native tile 64x64 (opaque, seamless), anchor centre (32,32); stage 384x224.
geometry: Surface textures for the canyon's 3D walls and floors; the stage sets how many units a tile spans; art never sets a hitbox (none).
timing: rock 1 ticks; stone 1 ticks; causeway 1 ticks; bone 1 ticks; lava 1 ticks; mist 1 ticks (30 Hz). Durations are the rules' and live in assets/griffinwing/slots.json.
